faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Find answers to your most common questions about our sunglasses and services.

q1.question: What is UV protection?
q1.answer: UV protection is essential for safeguarding your eyes from harmful rays. Our sunglasses provide 100% UV protection, ensuring your eyes stay safe while looking stylish. Enjoy the sun without worry!

q2.question: How is shipping handled?
q2.answer: We offer fast and reliable shipping options for all orders. Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days. You will receive a tracking number once your order is shipped.

q3.question: What is your return policy?
q3.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unworn and in their original packaging. Please contact our support team for return instructions.

q4.question: How to care for sunglasses?
q4.answer: To maintain your sunglasses, clean the lenses with a microfiber cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials. Store them in a protective case when not in use.

q5.question: Do you offer warranties?
q5.answer: Yes, we provide a one-year warranty against manufacturing defects. This warranty covers repairs or replacements for any issues that arise during normal use. Please keep your receipt for warranty claims.

hero.title: Protect Your Eyes in Style
hero.description: Understanding UV protection isn't just about buzzwords; it's about safeguarding your long-term eye health while looking great. Learn why Nazra Store sunglasses are your best defense.

whatIsUV.title: What Exactly is UV Radiation?
whatIsUV.description: Ultraviolet (UV) radiation is a form of electromagnetic radiation that comes from the sun and artificial sources. While it's invisible to the human eye, its effects are very real. The two types most harmful to your eyes are UVA and UVB.

points.title: UVA Rays
points.description: Penetrate deeply into the skin and eyes, contributing to aging and potentially cataracts over time.

points.title: UVB Rays
points.description: More intense and damaging, these are the primary cause of sunburn and can lead to conditions like photokeratitis, cataracts, and pterygium.

whyUVMatters.title: Why True UV Protection is Non-Negotiable
whyUVMatters.description: Wearing sunglasses is about much more than fashion. It's a vital step in protecting your eye health from cumulative sun damage.

features.title: Prevents Eye Conditions
features.description: Regular exposure to UV light can increase the risk of serious conditions like cataracts, macular degeneration, and pinguecula.

features.title: Reduces Glare & Enhances Comfort
features.description: Quality UV protection often comes with anti-glare properties, reducing eye strain and improving visual comfort, especially on bright days.

features.title: Protects Delicate Skin
features.description: The skin around your eyes is thin and susceptible to sun damage. Sunglasses add an extra layer of protection against premature aging and skin cancer.

nazraPromise.title: Nazra Store: Your Assurance of Protection
nazraPromise.description: Every pair of sunglasses at Nazra Store is selected to provide **100% UVA and UVB protection**, ensuring your eyes are safe without ever compromising on the latest styles. Don't settle for less when it comes to your vision.
